info.name: PM Platform API
info.description:
Postman collection for the PM Platform API.

HOW TO RUN: start the stack (docker compose up --build), import this collection, then use the Collection Runner (Run collection) to execute every request in order. The first run registers fresh users (alice, bob, carol) with unique emails, so it can be repeated at will.

Requests run as Alice by default (collection-level Bearer {{aliceToken}}). Requests that act as Bob or Carol override the authorization. Every request has tests that check the status code and the key fields of the response, including the PBAC rules (403 / 404 cases).

Variable baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:8000.

item.name: Register with an email that is already taken

exec: pm.test('Returns an access and a refresh token', () => { pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.refresh_token).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Returns an access and a refresh token', () => { pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.refresh_token).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Starts active with the creator as the only member', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(body.member_count).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Creator has every permission', () => pm.expect(body.permissions).to.eql({ update: true, delete: true, manage_members: true }));

exec: pm.test('Permissions are all false', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().permissions).to.eql({ update: false, delete: false, manage_members: false }));
